object.description: Accepted, no test. With read-only mode off, change DOC-1's object file from another program without activating the window, then edit DOC-1 from the window so that the edit is refused because its file changed (MELLON-STORE-SRS-182). Expected: the Changed on disk banner shows. Do the same with a commit refused under MELLON-GUI-SRS-111. Expected: the banner shows.
